battle.name: 貝州之戰
battle.brief: 興元元年五月，澤潞節度使李抱真與恆冀深趙四州節度使王武俊聯兵救魏州，進逼貝州，與范陽節度使朱滔、回紇騎兵戰於清河縣北三十里。初六晨，回紇騎兵衝陣既敗，桑林伏兵橫截退路，朱滔三萬眾死傷逃散過半，夜燒營奔德州。卡面羅馬短劍非唐軍制式，然短兵相接以刺突與步法為要，與環首刀、橫刀相通。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 交戰一方是唐朝河朔的聯軍，主體由兩道節度使的軍鎮組成。第一路是澤潞節度使李抱真所領的昭義軍，鎮兵久在河東、河北之間與朱氏爭鬥，慣於輕裝出擊與夜中行軍；第二路是恆冀深趙四州節度使王武俊所領的成德軍，治所在常山，是河朔諸鎮中兵眾與騎兵都算強的一支，士卒長於控弦與縱騎衝撞。聯軍之外，尚有魏州節度使田緒所部魏博軍被圍在城中等援，貝州與魏州一南一北，互為犄角。另一方是范陽節度使朱滔所領的幽州、檀州兵；朱泚在長安稱帝之後冊朱滔為皇太弟，兩人南北呼應，朱滔又借得回紇騎兵二千，恃其奔突之利。回紇兵由首領達干率領，經楊布、蔡雄引見，軍令與糧秣卻仍握在朱滔手中，權責不統一，這是對方在組織上最明顯的弱點，也是此役可以取勝的著眼處。
countriesEn: One party in this battle was the Tang allied army of Heshuo, whose strength was made up of the garrisons of two military governorships. The first was the Zhaoyi Army under Li Baozhen, military governor of Zelu; his men had long fought the Zhu interests between Hedong and Hebei and were used to striking with light kit and marching by night. The second was the Chengde Army under Wang Wujun, military governor of the four circuits of Heng, Ji, Shen and Zhao, seated at Changshan, one of the strongest of the commands of Heshuo in both numbers and cavalry, and famous for riding the bow and for the charge of mounted squadrons. Alongside the allies stood the Weibo Army of Tian Xu, military governor of Weizhou, shut up inside his city and waiting for relief, so that Weizhou and Binzhou, one south and one north, watched each other's flank. The other party was the army of Zhu Tao, military governor of Fanyang, with the troops of Youzhou and Tanzhou; after Zhu Ci had assumed the imperial title at Chang'an he enfeoffed Zhu Tao as heir apparent, the two of them answering each other from north and south, and Zhu Tao further borrowed two thousand Uighur horsemen, relying on the shock of their charge. The Uighur were led by their own chief Dagan, brought in by Yang Bu and Cai Xiong; the orders and the supplies, however, remained in Zhu Tao's hands, and the divided authority was the clearest structural weakness on that side, and the point on which the victory could be won.
people: 李抱真是聯軍的西翼主將，澤潞節度使，長期與河朔朱氏勢力周旋，此次出兵目的在解魏州、貝州之圍並保住河朔東路；他派部將賈林赴成德軍說服王武俊，是此役在開戰之前最關鍵的一步棋。賈林把朱滔南下的第一步說成是討平魏博，指出魏州、貝州若失，義武軍節度使張孝忠也將歸附朱滔，昭義軍則退保西山，河朔將盡為朱滔所有，據此說動王武俊同日出兵。王武俊是恆冀深趙四州節度使，割據成德多年，把持河朔東路，與李抱真同為藩鎮割據的受益者，此役卻必須以聯軍姿態介入。兵馬使趙琳領五百騎在經城西南桑林設伏，是全場最要害的一著。對面主將朱滔與朱泚同出幽州，早年相狎暱，發兵前召回部將馬寔自冠氏入守貝州，避聯軍鋒銳；楊布、蔡雄引回紇首領達干見朱滔，誇耀回紇兵善於突擊，催促速戰，戰後朱滔反以此二人為由將其殺死。
peopleEn: Li Baozhen was the commander of the western wing of the allied army, military governor of Zelu, long used to wrestling with the Zhu family in Heshuo, and on this occasion he marched out both to raise the siege of Weizhou and Binzhou and to hold the eastern road of Heshuo open. His emissary Jia Lin, who went to the camp of Wang Wujun to argue the case, made the most important single move of the campaign before any fighting began. Jia Lin presented Zhu Tao's march to the south as the first step towards the reduction of Weibo, and showed that if Weizhou and Binzhou were lost then Zhang Xiaozhong, military governor of Yiwu, would go over to Zhu Tao as well, that the Zhaoyi Army would have to retire behind the western mountains, and that the whole of Heshuo would end in Zhu Tao's hands; with this he persuaded Wang Wujun to march out on the same day. Wang Wujun, military governor of the four circuits of Heng, Ji, Shen and Zhao, had held Chengde for years and controlled the eastern road of Heshuo; like Li Baozhen he was one of the beneficiaries of the separatist commands, yet here he had to enter the field as part of a coalition. Zhao Lin, commander of the cavalry, led five hundred riders into ambush among the mulberries southwest of Jingcheng, and that was the weightiest stroke of the whole day. On the other side Zhu Tao, who was of the same family as Zhu Ci and had known him closely in youth, recalled his general Ma Shi from Guanshi to hold Binzhou and avoided the edge of the allied army; Yang Bu and Cai Xiong brought the Uighur chief Dagan before him and boasted of the skill of the Uighur in the shock action, pressing for an immediate battle. After the defeat Zhu Tao put the blame on Yang Bu and Cai Xiong for this and had them killed.
kits: 卡面所配的羅馬短劍是刺擊型單手短劍的代表形制，出自公元前一世紀的羅馬兵工，並不在唐軍編制之內；唐代戰場上位置相當的，是步騎通用的環首刀、直刃唐刀與隨身佩帶的短刀。環首刀單刃直身，刀首回環成環柄，格擋與劈砍並顧，既能斬，也能如短劍一般以刀尖抵刺貼身之敵；短兵相接靠的是盾的咬合、腳步的節奏與乾淨的一刺，而不是揮砍，這一點在貝州城下的貼身格鬥中，兩者是相通的。兩軍的配置大致如此：步兵以長槊、環首刀配弓箭成列，騎兵佩長刀、弓箭與少量馬槊；甲胄用皮甲、札甲與明光甲，重披膊只給精騎與軍官；角弓配箭，臂張弩與蹶張弩供破陣與守城；攻城用雲梯、撞木、飛石與鉤索，守方則靠木拒馬、柵欄及城上的矢石。回紇騎兵善用長弓與高昌式彎刀，衝鋒全恃馬速與回轉的空間。糧秣方面，聯軍就地取糧於河北平原的粟麥產區，戰線北推之際則倚靠河東與衛州方向的轉輸。
kitsEn: The Roman gladius on the card is the representative form of the single handed thrusting shortsword, a product of the Roman workshops of the first century before the common era, and it was not part of the Tang order of battle; the piece that stood in the same place on a Tang battlefield was the ring-pommel dao, the straight-edged Tang dao and the short knife carried at the girdle, all used by both foot and horse. The ring-pommel dao had a single straight blade with the pommel folded back into a ring for the hand; it served for the cut and for the block alike, and it could thrust at a close enemy as a shortsword does; in close fighting what counted was the bite of the shield, the rhythm of the footwork and one clean thrust, not the swing, and in that respect the two were the same in the hand-to-hand struggles below the walls of Binzhou. The equipment of the two armies was broadly as follows: infantry formed up with long lances, ring-pommel daos and bows, cavalry carried long sabres, bows and a few horse lances; armour was of leather, lacquered scale and bright plate, and the heavy harness was given only to picked horse and to officers; composite bows went with arrows, while bow-arms and crossbows served for breaking formations and for the defence of walls; siege work used scaling ladders, rams, stone-throwers and grappling ropes, and the defenders answered with wooden cheval-de-frise, barricades and the arrows and stones of the walls. The Uighur horsemen were skilled with the long bow and with the Khotan style sabre, and their charge relied wholly on the speed of the horse and on the room to wheel. As for supplies, the allied army drew grain on the spot from the millet and wheat country of the Hebei plain, and as the line pushed northward it leaned on the transport that came by way of Hedong and of Weizhou.
tactics: 聯軍的戰法分三層。第一層在開戰之前：賈林遊說成功，兩軍議定同日出征，免得被朱滔與各路叛軍各個擊破；主力在鉅鹿東會師，逼近貝州三十里擺開戰場，搶在朱滔合圍魏州之前逼他分兵。第二層在初六日清晨的會戰：王武俊引騎兵在前，李抱真列方陣殿後穩住正面；兵馬使趙琳率五百騎在經城西南的桑林一帶埋於側翼；回紇騎兵恃快馬先馳，衝擊聯軍陣腳企圖攪亂，王武俊約束騎兵控馬周旋，不與其硬碰，待其衝勢用盡、掉頭欲退，方縱兵追擊；此時桑林伏兵橫向截擊，回紇騎兵首尾不能相顧，敗走。追擊之中，朱滔的騎兵也收兵後撤，自行踐踏己方步兵陣地，步兵爭相東奔，全軍失去控馭，王武俊與李抱真合兵掩殺，朱滔只以數千人退入營壘。第三層在收尾：黃昏大霧驟起，視線受阻，李抱真在戰地西北、王武俊在東北分紮兩營；朱滔趁夜燒營自南門突出，奔德州，聯軍為霧氣所礙不敢追擊，遂放過了一次全殲的機會。
tacticsEn: The method of the allied army can be divided into three layers. The first was before the fighting began: the persuasion of Jia Lin had succeeded, the two armies agreed to march out on the same day so that Zhu Tao and the rebels on every side could not destroy them one by one; the main body joined hands east of Julu, pressed to within thirty li of Binzhou and deployed for battle, forcing Zhu Tao to divide his strength before he could close around Weizhou. The second was the engagement of the morning of the sixth day: Wang Wujun led the cavalry in front and Li Baozhen drew up a square formation in the rear to steady the front; Zhao Lin, commander of the cavalry, lay five hundred riders in ambush on the flank among the mulberries southwest of Jingcheng; the Uighur horsemen, trusting the speed of their horses, charged first and strove to throw the allied line into disorder, but Wang Wujun held his riders in hand, checked the horses and wheeled with them instead of colliding, and only when the weight of the charge was spent and the Uighur turned to withdraw did he loose his own cavalry in pursuit; at that moment the riders hidden among the mulberries struck across their line, the Uighur could no longer look after their head and their tail, and they were routed. In the pursuit Zhu Tao's own horse also broke off and fell back, trampling the infantry formation of his side, the foot soldiers ran east in disorder, and the whole army slipped out of the hand of its commander; Wang Wujun and Li Baozhen joined forces and cut the routed down, and Zhu Tao was able to retire into his camp with a few thousand men only. The third was the closing of the action: at dusk a thick fog came up and cut off the sight, Li Baozhen pitched camp to the north-west of the field and Wang Wujun to the north-east; Zhu Tao took advantage of the night, burned his camp, broke out by the south gate and ran for Dezhou, while the allied army, held up by the fog, did not dare to pursue and let slip the chance of destroying him entirely.
data: 可引的數字有限，只取有根據者。時間上，戰役在興元元年五月初六日清晨開打，交戰自晨至昏。朱滔南下的總兵力記為五萬，其中回紇騎兵二千騎；初六日出戰的兵力記為三萬人，戰後死亡者一萬餘人，逃散者一萬餘人，餘數千人隨朱滔入營固守。聯軍方面，兵馬使趙琳所領的伏兵為五百騎。距離上，聯軍列陣處在貝州城北三十里；經城在魏州治所貴鄉縣（今河北大名縣東北）的東北方，桑林伏兵地帶正在經城西南，聯軍正是從這片桑林間地切入了回紇騎兵的退路；會師地在鉅鹿（今河北巨鹿縣）以東，貝州治清河縣，冠氏在戰線之北，德州在戰線之南。制度面，安史之亂後唐廷在河北設恆冀深趙、魏博、義武等節度使，每鎮兵額自數萬至十餘萬不等，故一州被圍往往牽動數鎮。時間跨度上，自興元元年秋涇原兵變、朱泚稱帝建元應天，到五月此戰不過數月；同一時期唐廷在關中的收復戰事仍在渭河沿岸進行，李晟孤軍尚未出擊。
dataEn: The figures that can be given are few, and only those with a basis are taken. In time, the battle was fought on the morning of the sixth day of the fifth month of the first year of Xingyuan, and the action ran from morning until dusk. The total force with which Zhu Tao marched south is recorded at fifty thousand, of whom two thousand were Uighur horsemen; the force he brought into the field on the sixth day is recorded at thirty thousand men, of whom more than ten thousand were killed, more than ten thousand scattered, and a few thousand followed Zhu Tao back into the camp and held it. On the allied side the ambush under Zhao Lin amounted to five hundred riders. In distance, the allied line was deployed thirty li north of the city of Binzhou; Jingcheng lay to the north-east of the seat of Weizhou at Guixiang county, in what is now the north-east of Daming county in Hebei, and the ground of the mulberry ambush was to the south-west of Jingcheng, so that the allied army cut the retreat of the Uighur horsemen precisely across those mulberry grounds; the place of rendezvous was east of Julu, in what is now Julu county in Hebei, Binzhou had its seat at Qinghe county, Guanshi lay to the north of the line and Dezhou to the south. On the institutional side, after the An Lushan rebellion the court set up in Hebei such commands as Heng-Ji-Shen-Zhao, Weibo and Yiwu, with quotas of troops from several tens of thousands to more than a hundred thousand in each, so that a single besieged city generally drew in several commands. In span of time, only a few months separate the Jingyuan mutiny in the autumn of the first year of Xingyuan and Zhu Ci's assumption of the title with the era name Yingtian from the battle of the fifth month; in the same months the operations for the recovery of Guanzhong were still being fought along the Wei, where the army of Li Sheng stood alone and had not yet struck.
cause: 此戰的根子是安史之亂後形成的藩鎮割據。德宗即位即思削藩，追奪河朔諸鎮的兵權與財權，河北諸鎮則以擁兵自重、陽奉陰違為應對，彼此的裂痕愈演愈烈。興元元年秋涇原兵變，朱泚入長安稱帝建元應天，這給河朔一個共同的藉口：朱泚冊朱滔為皇太弟，朱滔便以奉迎朝廷、平定叛亂的名號自幽州南下，擁眾五萬，先圖貝州、再取魏州。魏州節度使田緒前一年殺田悅自領其眾，魏博人心未定；貝州是河北重鎮，一旦與魏州同失，義武軍節度使張孝忠勢必被裹挾，昭義軍只能退保西山，河朔全境都會落入朱滔之手。這種共同的恐懼把李抱真與王武俊推到同一條戰線上：澤潞軍奉朝廷之命勤王，成德軍則為保地自保，於是有了鉅鹿會師與貝州列陣。
causeEn: The root of this war was the system of separatist commands that had formed after the An Lushan rebellion. As soon as he came to the throne Dezong sought to reduce the commands and to take back their power over soldiers and over money, and the commands in Hebei answered by keeping troops of their own and professing obedience while acting otherwise; the rift between court and regions widened year by year. In the autumn of the first year of Xingyuan the Jingyuan garrison mutinied, and when Zhu Ci entered Chang'an and took the imperial title with the era name Yingtian, the whole of Heshuo was given a common pretext: Zhu Ci enfeoffed Zhu Tao as heir apparent, and thereupon Zhu Tao marched south from Youzhou under the banner of welcoming the court and of putting down the rebellion, gathering fifty thousand men, and turned first upon Binzhou and then upon Weizhou. In the year before, Tian Xu, military governor of Weizhou, had killed Tian Yue and seized his command for himself, and the hearts of the men of Weibo were not settled; Binzhou was a stronghold of Hebei, and if it fell together with Weizhou then Zhang Xiaozhong, military governor of Yiwu, would be dragged along with it, the Zhaoyi Army would have to fall back behind the western mountains, and all of Heshuo would pass under the hand of Zhu Tao. It was this shared fear that pushed Li Baozhen and Wang Wujun onto the same line: the army of Zelu came out in obedience to the court's call to serve, while the army of Chengde moved to save its own ground, and from this came the rendezvous at Julu and the deployment before Binzhou.
impact: 貝州之戰的直接後果是朱滔南下的計劃破產，魏州與貝州兩處圍解，河朔東西兩大藩鎮第一次以聯兵的姿態面對同一個敵人，這種並肩作戰的關係在往後數年成為唐廷在河北倚重方鎮的重要憑據。對朱滔本人，此役是沉重的一擊：出戰的三萬人損折過半，主張速戰的楊布、蔡雄被殺，他的指揮權與部下對他的信任同時受損；其後他退守幽州一帶，河北的亂局卻仍未平定，朝廷此後起用一批將領陸續收拾局面，河朔依然是唐廷最難處置的心腹大患。對唐廷而言，此役再一次顯示了削藩政策在安史之亂後的局限：中央既無力獨力平叛，就只能倚仗澤潞、成德、魏博諸鎮互相消耗，這種以藩鎮制藩鎮的辦法在短期內保住了失地，卻加深了軍令與財權分散的病態。軍事技術上，此役留下了一份教科書式的騎兵戰樣本：正面控馬周旋以消耗對手的衝鋒、側翼桑林伏兵橫向截斷退路、合兵掩殺追擊潰散之眾，而大霧與夜色又讓勝者失去收官的一擊，成敗之際全在幾個時辰的天光與士氣。
impactEn: The immediate result of the battle of Binzhou was the ruin of Zhu Tao's plan for the south and the lifting of the sieges of both Weizhou and Binzhou; for the first time the two great commands of eastern and western Heshuo stood in the field against one and the same enemy, and the sense of having fought shoulder to shoulder remained for years afterwards one of the chief supports of the court's reliance on the regional commands in Hebei. For Zhu Tao himself the blow was heavy: over half of the thirty thousand men he had brought into the field were lost, Yang Bu and Cai Xiong, who had pressed for an immediate battle, were killed, and both his command and the confidence of his men in him were damaged. He fell back to the neighbourhood of Youzhou afterwards, but the disorder in Hebei was not settled, and the court in later years used a succession of generals to clean it up piecemeal; Heshuo remained the sore that the Tang court found hardest to deal with. For the court the campaign once more showed the limits of the policy of reducing the commands after the An Lushan rebellion: with no strength of its own to put down a rebellion, the centre could only rely on the commands of Zelu, Chengde and Weibo wearing each other down, and while this device of using one command against another preserved the lost territory in the short run, it deepened the disease of divided command and divided revenue. At the level of military technique the battle left a textbook model of cavalry action: holding the horses in hand and wheeling in front so as to spend the enemy's charge, hidden riders striking across the line of retreat from the mulberry ambush on the flank, the two armies joining to cut down the scattered; and then the fog and the night taking from the victor the last stroke that would have ended the business, so that the whole issue turned on the light and on the spirits of the men in a few hours of the day.
result: 興元元年五月初六日清晨，王武俊與李抱真的聯軍在貝州城北三十里與朱滔及回紇騎兵接戰。回紇騎兵先馳衝陣，衝勢既竭、掉頭欲退時，遭趙琳部五百騎自桑林橫向截擊，敗走；王武俊縱騎追擊，朱滔自收其騎兵，踐踏己方步兵陣地，步兵東奔，軍心崩解，朱滔遂收殘卒入營固守。交戰自晨至昏，朱滔三萬出戰之眾，陣亡者一萬餘、逃散者一萬餘，餘數千人入營。是夜大霧瀰漫，李抱真在戰地西北、王武俊在東北分紮兩營；朱滔連夜燒營，自南門突出，率部奔德州，沿途丟棄掠奪的資財堆積如山，聯軍為霧氣所礙不敢追擊，朱滔乃得脫身。朱滔出關之後，反怪楊布、蔡雄主張速戰誤事，將二人殺死，自此河北再無可用之謀臣。魏州與貝州之圍得以解，澤潞與成德兩軍得勝而還；但朱滔主力未殲、本人未被擒，河北的割據與叛亂並未因此結束，這場戰役只是把河朔的亂局推回到更長遠的僵持之中。
resultEn: On the morning of the sixth day of the fifth month of the first year of Xingyuan, the allied army of Wang Wujun and Li Baozhen engaged Zhu Tao and his Uighur horsemen thirty li north of the city of Binzhou. The Uighur charged first, and when the weight of their charge was spent and they turned to withdraw they were cut across by the five hundred riders of Zhao Lin from the mulberry ambush and were routed; Wang Wujun loosed his cavalry in pursuit, Zhu Tao drew his own horse back and in doing so trampled the infantry formation of his own side, the foot soldiers ran east, the army lost its cohesion, and Zhu Tao gathered the remnants into his camp and held it. The action ran from morning until dusk; of the thirty thousand men whom Zhu Tao brought into the field, more than ten thousand were killed, more than ten thousand scattered, and a few thousand entered the camp. That night a thick fog spread over the field, Li Baozhen pitched to the north-west of the ground and Wang Wujun to the north-east; Zhu Tao burned his camp, broke out by the south gate and ran for Dezhou, leaving behind along the road the plunder he had gathered in heaps like a hill, while the allied army, held up by the fog, did not dare to pursue, and so Zhu Tao made good his escape. Once clear of the pass he put the blame on Yang Bu and Cai Xiong, saying that they had ruined matters by pressing for a pitched battle, and had them killed; from that point the north of Hebei had no more counsellors whom he could use. The sieges of Weizhou and Binzhou were lifted, and the armies of Zelu and Chengde returned in triumph; but the main body of Zhu Tao had not been destroyed and he had not been taken, and neither the separatism nor the rebellions of Hebei came to an end because of this. The battle only pushed the disorder of Heshuo back into a longer stalemate.
